\begin{example} \end{example}[Minimal immersions and harmonic maps (Example K.13)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0359 ↗ def:chow-iv-k12-harmonic-map 1. appk:K.13\group Harmonic Maps

For a smooth immersion $f$, its mean curvature vector is $\Delta _{f^*h,h}f$. Hence an isometric immersion is minimal exactly when it is harmonic. \end{example}
